ideas.title: Uncovering the Truth Behind the Minneapolis Shooting
ideas.description: Investigate the circumstances surrounding the shooting death of Alex Pretti and the Trump administration's response to the incident.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and investigate potential cover-ups
questions: What were the circumstances surrounding the shooting?
How did the Trump administration respond to the incident?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale scandal and reveal the truth behind the Minneapolis shooting.

ideas.title: Exposing Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota

questions: What is the extent of the Medicaid fraud scandal in Minnesota?
Who are the individuals and organizations involved?
